scenario: promo that steps up above today's rate, declined

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi, this is Alex, am I speaking with Summit Fiber?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi Taylor. I'm an AI assistant calling for Vedant. I'm calling about the account under his name and going over the bill.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: The monthly cost is higher than what's advertised right now. What promotions or adjustments are available on it?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: You're at $89.99. I've got a promo: $15 off for six months, but at the end of the six months the plan steps up to the current list price, which is $95.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: So $74.99 for six months, then $95 after, which is more than today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That's right. It's the standard promo rollout.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Is that the best rate available on the account? Anything that doesn't go up afterward?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That's the only one I've got.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'd have to check with him on that, since it ends up higher than today. Let's leave the plan as is for now.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: No problem. It'll be there if he changes his mind.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Just to confirm, the only offer is $15 off for six months then $95 a month after, and we're leaving the plan unchanged for now. Thanks Taylor, bye.

notes: The promo reverts above today's price, so the agent declined it. Nothing changed: action none, no saving.
